name: imap-plugin
description: Provider-independent local IMAP/SMTP operator for Codex on Windows and macOS with automatic two-field setup and native review for every change.

interface.longDescription: Connect one standards-based mailbox locally with only an email address and password. Read and search within strict bounds, inspect suspicious or advertising mail, and perform exact single or bulk actions only after separate native local review.
defaultPrompt: Check the status of my IMAP connection.
Search recent mail in one folder.
Inspect recent advertising mail and show the exact unsubscribe options first.
